description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Heir of Seto Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Heir of Seto Mode
description.text: Grants [Buff Earth 10% (15s)] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using Earth abilities, removed after triggering three times
